purpose: Thirty non-compensatory lenses for auditing FASE 29 temporal memory, dataset rights and falsifier evidence.

lenses.question: Do derived counts and formulas reproduce source values?
Is every legal assertion backed by exact terms or explicit TOKEN_VAZIO?
Are occurrence and recording times separated?
Does each event descend from a valid previous hash?
Are negative findings prevented from being outweighed by positive counts?
Are unknowns represented explicitly instead of null or invented values?
Are identifiers unique and duplicate evidence rejected?
Does every open gap carry a repair path and exit criterion?
Are release totals separated from observations actually used?
Does claim_allowed remain false at every layer?
Are unresolved fields counted rather than averaged away?
Do claimed values point to concrete repository sources?
Do notes avoid claiming that one failed criterion proves a competing theory?
Are parameter count, sample count and degrees of freedom distinct?
Are F-COS-01 through F-COS-05 all represented exactly once?
Does each status match its threshold operator and observed value?
Are schemas, bundle IDs, dataset IDs and event IDs explicit?
Are methods, source paths and source phases recorded?
Can no quantity of PASS labels promote the global claim?
Do failed falsifiers retain scope, uncertainty and limitation?
Is recorded_at never earlier than effective_at?
Are distinct datasets and evidence contexts kept separate?
Are event IDs and recording order append-only and monotonic?
Are uncertainty, convergence and arbitrary thresholds disclosed?
Do referenced local artifacts exist?
Do summaries equal the exact underlying sets?
Does absent holdout keep training and predictive claims blocked?
Does the hash chain make mutation or deletion observable?
Do gaps name owner, next action and exit criterion?
Are schema version and migration boundary explicit?

promotion_rule: All mandatory lenses must pass; a mean score cannot hide a failed lens.
